# DistanceToWhiteNoise {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
DistanceToWhiteNoise()
```
Chart choice for the Δ-chart. The statistic measures the squared Euclidean distance of the ordinal-pattern distribution to the uniform distribution obtained under white noise. See Equation (3) in Weiß and Testik (2023).
 


:::
